WITH expired_jobs as (
            SELECT job_id
            FROM jobs
            WHERE
                status = 'running'
                AND lease_expires_at <= now()
            ORDER BY
                lease_expires_at ASC,
                job_id ASC
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            LIMIT $1
        )
        UPDATE jobs as job
        SET
            status = CASE
                WHEN job.attempts >= job.max_attempts THEN 'dead'
                ELSE 'queued'
            END,

            run_at = CASE
                WHEN job.attempts >= job.max_attempts THEN job.run_at
                ELSE now() + ($2::BIGINT * INTERVAL '1 second')
            END,

            completed_at = CASE
                WHEN job.attempts >= job.max_attempts THEN now()
                ELSE NULL
            END,

            last_error = CASE
                WHEN job.attempts >= job.max_attempts THEN 'worker lease expired after final attempt'
                ELSE 'worker lease expired before completion'
            END,

            locked_at = NULL,
            locked_by = NULL,
            lease_expires_at = NULL

        FROM expired_jobs
        WHERE job.job_id = expired_jobs.job_id
        RETURNING job.status
